Exact native invocation/action/canonical request digest/context/current effect authorization/operation receipt/parent source closure selected profile+owner generation plus actual transport receipt and captured body bytes retained by root handler. artifact_identity: Dynamic bounded captured content only, not a static seed ArtifactCatalog row. Existing generic artifact ID regex is not broadened; this dedicated root registry resolves exact namespace and actual held CAS identity. SHA addresses bytes, while receipt handle separately binds per-profile/current invocation/provenance. Equal public bytes never merge private authority/source contexts.
CAS: ProtectedRootJournal private root child web-content/<SHA256(profile_id UTF8)>/objects/<raw_body_sha256>; secure owner0 mode0700 parents nofollow, exclusive tmp write/fsync/atomic create or exact existing-byte reopen, immutable0400/0444 file no execute, held FD/dev/inode/size/hash. <=2097152 raw bytes and existing lower fetch cap; quota/lease cleanup under same owner profile, no path crossing worker API. source_receipt_domain: source_receipt_handle is this dedicated registry opaque root observed web-content provenance receipt, not fabricated SourceObserverRegistry ingress token or provider-authority SourceReceipt. Native result validator calls this exact resolver. Root transcript/memory source collector retains and resolves its transport/content/effect/parent ancestry; text remains untrusted-public-source with authority none and original parent sensitivity restrictions. Never promote web dictionary to signed source authority or strip parent private lineage.
serializer: Root web handler publishes actual captured raw bytes and joins PublicSourceReceipt actual TLS/peer/status/redirect/request facts to the same authorized fetch. Existing native outer key set url/content_type/content/untrusted_source/authority/redirects/source_receipt unchanged; source_receipt replaced only by genuine resolved v120 metadata. content decoding comes from captured bytes through selected charset/content serializer; raw bytes SHA remains raw bytes, not string re-encoding hash. currentness: Cap <=30s by selected effect/native invocation/profile/source leases; validate service/owner generation/current registry/signature/source ancestry/transport/CAS each resolve and before transcript use. Expire/revoke closes FDs and invalidates handles; new boot cannot adopt old monotonic receipt without fresh actual observation. v120 receipt numeric finite expiry and canonical result <=2MiB unchanged. No redirect policy broadened by result schema maxItems32.
